exposure: Intravenous fluids in combination with ephedrine
cohort: The study included 80 adult patients aged 17-45 years undergoing urological pelvic surgery under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Ephedrine combined with intravenous fluids significantly improved systolic and diastolic blood pressure and enhanced haemodynamic stability compared to fluids alone during spinal anaesthesia for urological pelvic surgery.
